title: I Just Want to Ruin nether Ceiling
description: Allow you to directly ruin and break nether ceiling with ruin bottle,rather than creating a portal you possibly don't want.
body:
At long time ago,you can ruin nether ceiling and dig it to create a tunnel,that is quite a vital QoL.However since Spectrum version 1.8 ,you cannot ruin nether ceiling instead it will create a portal link to the bottom of nether.I could understand designer's intention,but I want it to be convenient.

Now you can directly ruin the ceiling with this Mod.
